initial_findings.finding: Observed pair role_issue accepted any non-empty string and was not compared with the production role assessment.
initial_findings.resolution: All 50 observed pairs now reconstruct the expected outcome and issue through production assess_ticket_roles and require an exact match. Regression tests cover unknown, wrong-but-valid, and last-item mutations.

initial_findings.finding: A partially rewritten formal evaluation row could replace raw results and derived hashes while retaining a stale request hash and run-context hash.
initial_findings.resolution: Normal, replayable, and idempotent paths now validate the exact runner version, complete run-context schema and hash, request hash, persisted authority, and reproduced formal report. The reviewed partial-row forgery is rejected.

initial_findings.finding: A boolean root schema_version could compare equal to integer one in the formal review package.
initial_findings.resolution: The root schema version now requires exact integer type and value; a boolean regression test is present.

initial_findings.finding: A future formal set with no normal pair could divide by zero while computing the normal-pair false-positive rate.
initial_findings.resolution: The metric now reports not_measured with a zero sample count; a red-green regression test covers the boundary.

remaining_boundaries: The exact-duplicate scenario proves only identical content hashes, not different hashes depicting the same ticket.
Derived scenarios prove deterministic safe routing only; they do not establish natural prevalence, real recall, or performance.
The formal manifest does not yet contain exhaustive per-image layout and quality labels, so those formal distributions remain not_measured.

Same-database hashes and append-only triggers do not defend against a privileged actor coherently rewriting the entire SQLite database and every authority hash; that would require an external trust root.
